objectives.text: Policies and procedures governing emergency lending under paragraph (3) shall be designed to ensure that any emergency lending program or facility is for the purpose of providing liquidity to the financial system, and not to aid a failing financial company.

citations.quote: Such policies and procedures shall be designed to ensure that any emergency lending program or facility is for the purpose of providing liquidity to the financial system, and not to aid a failing financial company

objectives.text: Security for emergency loans must be sufficient to protect taxpayers from losses and any such program must be terminated in a timely and orderly fashion.

notes: This source is the statutory text of 12 U.S.C. 343 (Federal Reserve Act s.13(3)) concerning discount-window/emergency lending authority. It does not itself discuss FHLB collateral/operational rules, discount-window stigma, Call Reports, FR 2052a, or reform proposals by Acting Comptroller Hsu or Undersecretary McKernan; those diagnostic elements described in the ratified scope are not present in this source and are therefore not extracted. Only the statutory obligations, definitions, objectives, and cross-references bearing on the discount-window emergency-lending framework as written are extracted here, preserved as written including its use of 'shall,' 'may,' and 'shall not' without harmonization. Ambiguities (e.g., undefined terms such as 'lendable value,' 'member bank,' and the negatively-defined 'program or facility with broad-based eligibility') are flagged rather than resolved, per the fidelity rule.
